Premium feature guide

Reframe in a click.
Edit at the speed of thought.

A screenshot-led guide to Vistora's project, reframing, script, graphics, transition and intelligent dialogue workflows — built for editors who deliver to every platform from one timeline.

00:01  / Feature chapter

Project intelligence

Start quickly. Stay organised.

Open a recent production or create a new project with 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 presets, project naming, Full HD resolution and frame-rate controls. Quick 9:16 supports social-first work while portable .vistora.json project files keep editing data manageable.

  • Recent-project access
  • 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 delivery presets
  • Resolution and 24/25/30/60 fps options
  • Quick vertical-video start
  • Portable project files and autosave after first save
00:02  / Feature chapter

Media and source preparation

Bring footage into focus.

Import files or folders, search and sort project media, then inspect selected clips in the Source monitor before editing. The workspace keeps format, duration, source marks and project delivery settings visible without leaving the main interface.

  • File and folder import
  • Searchable project media bin
  • Source and Program monitor modes
  • In/Out source preparation and subclip workflow
  • Project export format readout
00:03  / Feature chapter

Quick Vertical ReframeNew

16:9 to 9:16, without a second timeline.

Reframe horizontal footage for vertical platforms directly on the Program monitor. Drag the live 9:16 guide to choose the crop, preview the result instantly, and keyframe the position across a move — no duplicate sequence and no manual math.

  • Live 9:16 guide over any 16:9 frame
  • Manual reframe with left–right crop-position control
  • Keyframeable position for pans and reveals
  • One-click Guide and 9:16 Preview toggle
  • Reframe stays with the clip — no separate vertical project
00:04  / Feature chapter

Title Studio

Build titles for every platform.

Create openers, kinetic typography and platform-ready social titles. Place text directly on the canvas, then refine content, template, font, weight, size, colour, alignment, screen position and animation from the Inspector.

  • Openers and kinetic templates
  • YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and LinkedIn styles
  • Direct on-canvas positioning
  • Typography, colour and alignment controls
  • Animation controls and dedicated T1 title track
00:05  / Feature chapter

Transitions

Shape every cut with precision.

Apply transitions at edit points using a visual library. A colour-graded timeline bridge makes timing explicit while duration, easing and incoming-clip settings remain available in the Inspector.

  • Cross Dissolve, Wipes, Slides and Pushes
  • Zoom, Spin, Warp Zoom and Ripple Dissolve
  • Flash and additional transition styles
  • Visible 1.0-second bridge on the cut
  • Duration, alignment and easing controls
00:06  / Feature chapter

Script StudioNew

Edit the words. Cut the picture.

Transcribe a clip, then edit from the script instead of the waveform. Click any line to jump to that timecode, select lines to mark In/Out or make a subclip, and export or import .srt without leaving the project.

  • One-click Transcribe with segmented, timecoded text
  • Click-to-jump script navigation
  • Select lines to Mark I/O, subclip or insert
  • Export .srt and Import .srt
  • Optional burn-in captions for preview and export
00:07  / Feature chapter

AI Dialogue Studio

Make every voice clear.

Enhance spoken audio in one click and reduce unwanted vocal noise without leaving the edit. Compare Original and Enhanced playback, choose Natural, Clear or Strong processing, then refine Presence, de-essing, compression and Auto Level.

  • One-click Enhance Voice
  • Vocal noise reduction guided by a marked quiet section
  • Original versus Enhanced comparison
  • Natural, Clear and Strong processing strengths
  • Presence, de-ess, compression and Auto Level
  • Social, Podcast and Broadcast output targets
00:08  / Feature chapter

Editing workspace

A focused environment for real timelines.

Work with Project Media, Source and Program monitors, Inspector controls and a multi-track timeline in one coherent interface. T1, V2, V1 and A1 keep titles, overlays, primary picture and audio structurally clear.

  • Project Media and sequence management
  • Source and Program monitoring
  • T1 titles, V2 overlay, V1 picture and A1 audio
  • Selection, Blade, split, trim and ripple workflows
  • Markers, In/Out, insert, overwrite and undo
00:09  / Feature chapter

Product identity and release information

Built for creators. Engineered for performance.

The About panel provides clear beta version, build, codename and engine information together with direct access to release notes. This gives testers and support teams an exact product identity for diagnostics and feedback.

  • Vistora 0.9.0 Beta identity shown in the supplied build
  • Aurora codename
  • Media, Timeline, Playback and Render engine versions
  • Build identifier and release-notes access
AI Dialogue Studio

Enhance dialogue in seven steps

1Select a clip containing dialogue.
2Open Dialogue Studio and choose Enhance Voice.
3Mark a quiet, noise-only range when available and use it for analysis.
4Choose Natural, Clear or Strong processing.
5Compare Original and Enhanced playback.
6Optionally tune Presence, de-ess threshold, compression and Auto Level.
7Select a Social, Podcast or Broadcast output target, then export.
Release accuracy: describe enhancement as AI-based only when the installed beta includes and activates the intended model/runtime. State standard-processing fallback clearly when applicable.
